name: Elusai
title: Warrior from Benjamin who joined David
summary: Elusai (also known as Eluzai) was one of the Benjamite warriors who left Saul's side and joined David while he was in Ziklag. He was among the skilled warriors who could use both their right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows with a bow. His switch to David was an important sign that support for David was growing even among Saul's own tribe.

keyEvents.title: Joined David in Ziklag
keyEvents.description: Elusai was one of the Benjamite warriors who came to David in Ziklag while he was still fleeing from King Saul. These men left their own tribal king to support David.

keyEvents.title: Skilled warrior with both hands
keyEvents.description: Elusai and the other Benjamites who came to David were known for their ability to use both their right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows with a bow.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's heroes
keyEvents.description: Elusai was counted among the list of brave men who supported David and helped establish his kingdom in accordance with the Lord's word.

keyEvents.title: Part of growing support for David
keyEvents.description: The switch by Elusai and other Benjamites to David's side showed that God's plan to give David the kingdom was being fulfilled, as even Saul's own tribesmen left him.
